summary: Full test of the POT24 house games, the admin dashboard and controls, and the mlgame-style UI redesign. BACKEND: 18/18 pytest pass (test_iter16_house_games.py), and a separate live Matka settlement check passed. Covered: color/matka state shape and lock gaps (5s/10s); invalid picks and amounts give 400; a bet in the lock window gives 409; a real Color round across the round end with admin override 7 paid 9x number, 2x green, 2x big and 0 for red/violet (wallet net +80 checked), and the override auto-cleared; override 0 paid red 1.5x, violet 4.5x and small 2x; Matka override 7 paid single 9x and jodi 90x after a real 120s round. Andar, Teen (including tie refund), Break10, Ludo (played to completion) and Call Break (bid, illegal off-suit card gives 400, played to done) all reconcile with the wallet, and finished sessions give 409. Admin dashboard works for today/week/month and gives 403 to players. Aviator force 1.5 for 2 rounds gave crash_point 1.5 twice and then cleared; value null clears; audit logs are written. Profile summary and live feed both return 200. FRONTEND (390x844): login restyle (login-mandatory badge, PLAY • WIN • EARN) and login to /home work. All hub testids are present; View All links go to /games/all and /bet-on-player; INVITE NOW goes to /profile#referral. nav-menu opens nav-drawer with all links and nav-logout. Bottom nav goes to /club/vip|bonus|offers|rewards. Color: countdown ticks, a bet was placed and the balance was debited, and recent results and the table render. Matka: jodi bet placed. Andar, Teen, Break10, Ludo (played to BOT WINS) and Call Break (played to scores) all show results. How-to popups appear on first visit for all 7 games. Bet on Player tabs, game picker and JOIN SLOT (opens the game) work. The /games/all grid shows 13 games. Profile summary shows all ps-* fields. Aviator FUN mode made 0 API calls and the fun balance went 10,000 to 9,980; REAL mode called /games/aviator/start and debited the wallet. Admin overview shows KPIs, both charts, agent-panel and SET/CLEAR for all 3 controls, and an invalid value shows an error. Bugs found: Matka countdown format for rounds over 60s, Matka jodi input overflow, and an unhandled clipboard rejection.

minor.issue: Ties and pushes are recorded with result='lost' (won = mult>1), so profile win_rate, losses and last_matches count a refund as a loss.
Any action other than 'hit' (including null or garbage) is treated as 'stand'. There is no validation.

Fractional color/matka values are silently truncated with int() (3.7 becomes 3). take_aviator_force is a non-atomic read then write, so 2 concurrent aviator starts can both consume one 'remaining' round. Use find_one_and_update.
Settled history exposes server_seed_hash but never reveals server_seed, so the 'provably fair' claim for Color/Matka can't be verified by players.
Pre-existing: crash_point is returned to the client in the start response. With admin force this also reveals the forced value. Players can read it from devtools.

ui_bugs.issue: The time is built as `00:${secs}`.slice(-5), so when more than 99s are left it shows '0:113', and between 60 and 99s it shows '00:85' instead of '01:25'. It needs proper mm:ss formatting.
At 390px the input overflows its card (right edge 397px vs 357px for the singles grid) and causes horizontal page scroll (scrollWidth 397). Add min-w-0 w-full to the input.

ui_bugs.component: ProfileSummary referral copy (also Profile.js username copy)
ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText is not awaited or caught. When permission is denied it raises an uncaught runtime error overlay, and the 'Copied' popup shows even though the copy failed.

issues: The 'Game Wise Wagered' pie is sized by wagered amount, but the legend shows revenue (e.g. Teen Patti ₹-260). Rename it or show the wagered value.
Deposits vs Withdrawals chart is an empty box with no 'No data' empty state when there are no transactions.

design_issues.issue_note: The celebration shows a rounded prize (+20) while the result banner shows +19.5 (Break10).
issues: Win celebration amount is rounded and doesn't match the actual prize.
Live Deposits/Withdrawals show 'No activity yet' because the DB has no deposit/withdrawal transactions. This is correct, but looks empty for a fresh install.
The result only says 'Scores 2 / 2 / -1 / -2'. It doesn't clearly say YOU WON / YOU LOST, and a tie with a bot is a loss with no explanation.

action_items: Fix the Countdown formatting in TimedGame.js to mm:ss (Matka 120s round shows '0:113')
Add min-w-0/w-full to matka-jodi-input to stop the horizontal overflow on mobile
Wrap navigator.clipboard.writeText in try/catch (await) in ProfileSummary.js and Profile.js, and only show 'Copied' on success
Record ties/pushes (teen, break10) as a distinct 'push' result, not 'lost'
Optional: fix the pie legend label and the WinCelebration rounding; add an empty state for the deposits chart
critical_code_review_comments: house_games.py: _current_round can race between house_loop and /state requests and create 2 open rounds. The older one settles a second later, so it isn't harmful, but a unique index on {game, status:'open'} or a find_one_and_update upsert would be cleaner.
The aviator start response leaks crash_point (pre-existing). This is a serious fairness/security issue for a real-money game.
Server seeds for timed rounds are never revealed after settlement, so the fairness hash can't be checked.
Admin control payload allows any 'rounds' integer and float values for integer targets without validation.
seed_data_creation: Player 8800112233 main_balance set to 50000 by the test fixture. Test bets and games were created in color/matka/andar/teen/break10/ludo/callbreak/aviator. All admin overrides and aviator_force were cleared at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The onboarding guide localStorage key is 'timeup_guide_done' (not tu_guide_seen). How-to keys are tu_demo_seen_<game>. Login at /login goes straight to /home (via /splash). test_iter16_house_games.py takes about 85s (it waits for real color rounds). matka_settle_check.py waits up to about 2.5 min for a matka round. The Aviator fun round may still be flying when the mode is switched; mode toggles are blocked unless phase is idle.
